generate_orders_from_base_strategy_model: generate Diplomacy orders for a power using a base strategy model with configurable temperature and top-p sampling
generate_order_by_column_from_base_strat: produce all possible orders per unit location by forcing each position to try every valid action
get_all_possible_orders: enumerate all coordinated order combinations for a power using full or sampled Cartesian product of per-location options
generate_coordinated_local_modifications: generate coordinated action variations by modifying orders near specific locations while keeping distant orders fixed
generate_double_oracle_actions: generate actions for multiple powers combining uniform enumeration, column generation, base strategy model, and local modification strategies
